name: write-tab-inherits-bullet
request: Rewrite the tab from markdown: a heading and two plain paragraphs.
command:
sh -c "printf '# New title

First paragraph.

Second paragraph.
' > /tmp/gdt-micro-write.md && gdoc write --force --quiet --account {A} --tab '{TAB}' {DOC} /tmp/gdt-micro-write.md"
expected: Tab holds exactly: HEADING_1 `New title`, then two NORMAL_TEXT paragraphs with no bullets.
target: heading `New title`, paragraph beginning `First paragraph`, paragraph beginning `Second paragraph`
allowed: revision list grows; renumber; lists map; the old paragraphs are removed; empty spacer paragraphs between the new paragraphs
explain: The tab has an intro paragraph and a bulleted list, and the list runs to the very end of the tab. We asked gdoc to replace the whole tab with new content written in Markdown: a title and two plain paragraphs, no list. The new text is there, but every new paragraph, including the title, now has a bullet in front of it, inherited from the list that used to end the tab. This is the behaviour reported in gdoc issue 59. Look at the after tab: bullets in front of a title and of plain paragraphs, plus empty bulleted lines between them.
